targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM churn.predictions WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM churn.api_keys WHERE is_active = TRUE AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM churn.api_keys WHERE is_active = TRUE AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}')

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS value FROM churn.predictions WHERE requested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}')

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS value FROM churn.predictions WHERE requested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}')

SELECT date_trunc('hour', requested_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Predições" FROM churn.predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latência por Hora — p50 e p95 (ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', requested_at) AS time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS "p50" FROM churn.predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', requested_at) AS time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS "p95" FROM churn.predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ROUND(CAST(churn_prob AS numeric), 1)::text AS "Probabilidade", COUNT(*) AS "Contagem" FROM churn.predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.slug AS "Projeto", COUNT(*) AS "Predições" FROM churn.predictions pr JOIN churn.projects p ON p.id = pr.project_id WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.requested_at) AND pr.tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
